topic.title: Release notes for 0.2
topic.shortdesc: Readers can choose the version of the docs they read, and staff decide which versions they may choose.

ul.li: The label beside the site title can now be a version picker. Readers select it to read the docs of another version; pages, navigation, search, images and PDFs follow their choice. See .

Staff choose what it offers under Site & access → Version picker in the admin console: nothing (the default), each reader's own version, one fixed version for everyone, or a list of versions to choose from. See .
Switching changes only the version. Products and features still come from the reader's entitlements.
New admin API route PUT /admin/api/repos/:id/versions, a versionPicker field in seed files, the repo.versions audit action and migration 011_version_picker, applied on start.

section.title: Upgrading from 0.1
section.p: Deploy the new image. The migration adds one column with the picker off, so readers see no change until staff turn it on. See .
